basics.name: Kexin (Cathy) Lin
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate
basics.summary: Ph.D. Candidate in Business Administration at the Business School at Worcester Polytechnic Institute. My research integrates data envelopment analysis (DEA), mathematical optimization, and machine learning for performance evaluation, benchmarking, and decision support, with work on performance-oriented clustering and recommendation systems for digital platforms and empirical modeling for sustainable operations, supply chains, and urban energy systems.

work.name: The Business School, Worcester Polytechnic Institute
work.position: Teaching Assistant and Instructor for Selected Lessons
work.summary: Prepare instructional materials and deliver selected lessons on DEA and machine learning. Support undergraduate and graduate students through office hours, project guidance, grading, and feedback on analytical reasoning and interpretation of results.
highlights: OIE 548 Performance Analytics (Graduate). Support performance-analytics coursework through grading, office hours, and project guidance.
OIE 4410 Case Studies in Industrial Engineering (Undergraduate). Guest instruction on DEA; case-study project guidance, office hours, and assessment.
OIE 552 Modeling and Optimizing Processes (Graduate). Guide students in problem formulation, Excel Solver implementation, scenario analysis, and interpretation of optimization results.

Recent instructional design: Developing and adapting an Excel-based regression and K-nearest neighbors (KNN) module that combines conceptual explanations, guided demonstrations, hands-on exercises, and a small independent project. Emphasizes prediction, interpretation, and analytical support for business decisions.
